applicationName.description: Optional explicit name for the rendered ArgoCD Application. Defaults to a per-cluster derived name to avoid collisions when deployed to multiple clusters.

destination.description: Argo destination for the rendered Application. Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name) — at least one required. Template prefers `name` when both are set (so consumers can override the chart's default `server` with a `name` without nulling). `namespace` defaults to `postgres`, not upstream's `cnpg-system`.

monitoring.description: Prometheus Operator integration for the operator pod itself. Requires the Prometheus Operator CRDs on the target cluster.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the operator container. Empty object = upstream default (unset).

extraValues.description: Deep-merged on top of the computed valuesObject passed to the upstream chart.
